scope:
Bounded block-zero arithmetic controls over retained same-GGUF inputs.

This models the pinned CUDA Q4_K MMQ DS4 activation conversion on CPU, plus
separate Q/probability F16 controls. It does not emulate CUDA instruction/reduction
order, qualify a GPU kernel, or establish a speech-quality cause.

scalar_mmq_control.scope: tiny CPU algebra only; no CUDA execution
scalar_mmq_control.negative_control: original partial sums differ from reconstructed Q8 sums

modes.baseline_binding: bit-exact retained full7B F16-KV upstream block0

limitation: CPU algebra and explicit F16 rounding; not actual CUDA instruction/reduction-order emulation or a quality cause
decision: end algebra expansion at approximately0.48% residual CPU/CUDA reference gap; no audible or product-defect attribution from this numerical bound
